description: Situational briefing for a point: risk level, key facts, the best and worst windows in the next 24 hours, and the next rush-hour NO2 peak. Deterministic — computed from live data, not generated prose.

lat.description: Latitude of the point. Must be inside Flanders or Brussels. Pair with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of the point. Pair with lat.

locationId.description: Id of one of the account's saved locations, from stadiq_locations. Use instead of lat/lng.

name: stadiq_briefing
title: Operations briefing
